com.sun.tools.javac.model

类 FilteredMemberList

  • java.lang.Object
    • java.util.AbstractCollection<E>
      • java.util.AbstractList<Symbol>
        • com.sun.tools.javac.model.FilteredMemberList
  • 所有已实现的接口:
    Iterable<Symbol>, Collection<Symbol>, List<Symbol>

    public class FilteredMemberList
extends AbstractList<Symbol>
    Utility to construct a view of a symbol's members, filtering out unwanted elements such as synthetic ones. This view is most efficiently accessed through its iterator() method.

    This is NOT part of any supported API. If you write code that depends on this, you do so at your own risk. This code and its internal interfaces are subject to change or deletion without notice.

      • iterator

        public Iterator<Symbol> iterator()
        从类复制的说明: AbstractList
        Returns an iterator over the elements in this list in proper sequence.

        This implementation returns a straightforward implementation of the iterator interface, relying on the backing list's size(), get(int), and remove(int) methods.

        Note that the iterator returned by this method will throw an UnsupportedOperationException in response to its remove method unless the list's remove(int) method is overridden.

        This implementation can be made to throw runtime exceptions in the face of concurrent modification, as described in the specification for the (protected) AbstractList.modCount field.
